chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Ash'ari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya ibn 'Imran al-Halabi, from Ayyub ibn al-Hurr, who said:
I heard Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying:

Indeed Allah, Mighty is His remembrance, sealed the prophets with your Prophet, so there will never be any prophet after him; and He sealed the books with your Book, so there will never be any book after it. And He sent down in it the clarification of everything: your creation and the creation of the heavens and the earth, the account of those before you, the judgment of what is among you, the news of what will come after you, the matter of Paradise and the Fire, and what you are ultimately going to.

key_terms.نَبِيِّكُمُ: your Prophet, referring to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the finality of prophethood and the completeness of the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that Allah ended prophethood with Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and ended revealed books with the Qur'an. It also presents the Qur'an as containing clarification regarding creation, past nations, present judgments, future events, and the realities of Paradise and the Fire.
